title: Errors, exceptions, and using (failure handling and cleanup)
summary: Learn how the Common Language Runtime (CLR) signals failures with typed Exception objects, how try/catch/finally and when filters handle them, and why throw; preserves the stack trace while throw ex; destroys it. The using statement calls IDisposable.Dispose deterministically — essential for SkiaSharp and file streams. Finalizers are module 14; unobserved Task exceptions are module 13.
